valueProps.title: Why freelancers and studios build on Rerun.
valueProps.subtitle: You ship the Coworker, the client keeps it running. No infrastructure to rent, no handover doc nobody reads.

ship.title: Ship in days, not months
ship.desc: Start from ready-to-run Coworkers and {connectorCount}+ apps, one click each. Nothing to provision before your first demo.

harness.title: Build the harness, not just the prompt
harness.desc: Pick exactly what the Coworker can do: files, shell, web, memory, its own database, skills. Every capability is a switch.

board.title: Deliver a live board, not a chat log
board.desc: Runs, cost, success rate and what needs a human, live on the board. Your client sees the work happening without pinging you for a status.

handoff.title: Hand off without hand-holding
handoff.desc: Before anything sensitive, the Coworker stops and asks your client. They approve from the app or Slack, so you are not the one in the loop forever.

running.title: It keeps running after you leave
running.desc: Coworkers run 24/7 on the client's own machine, on a schedule or on a trigger. No babysitting, no emergency call at 2am.

improving.title: The Coworker you sold keeps improving
improving.desc: It writes down what it learns about the client, so the work you delivered gets sharper on its own instead of aging badly.

benefits.title: Grow faster as a Rerun Expert.
benefits.subtitle: One application, four ways to get paid for the work you already do.

listed.title: Get listed in the Expert directory
listed.desc: A public profile clients browse, filter by skill and budget, and contact in one click. Every brief that comes in lands straight in your inbox.

sandbox.title: Build for free in your sandbox
sandbox.desc: Expert accounts get a sandbox with no Coworker limit and no bill. Prototype, demo, then hand the finished Coworker over to the client.

templates.title: Keep 95% of your template sales
templates.desc: Package a Coworker as a template, publish it on the marketplace, and get paid every time someone installs it. You set the price, you keep 95% of every sale, and we handle the payout.

revenue.title: Earn 20% on every client you bring
revenue.desc: When a client you onboarded subscribes, you earn 20% of their Rerun plan, every month, for as long as they stay.
